description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set, which spans a total of 12 distinct domains. The chart is composed of 12 colored slices, each representing one domain, with the size of each slice proportional to the number of samples from that domain in the test set. While the specific domain names and their corresponding percentages are not legible in the provided image, the visual structure indicates a non-uniform distribution — some domains occupy larger segments, suggesting they are more heavily represented, while others are smaller. The chart includes a legend (partially visible) that maps each color to a specific domain, and percentage labels are likely present within or adjacent to each slice to quantify the proportion. One slice appears slightly exploded or offset from the rest, possibly to highlight a particular domain of interest. The overall design is clean and standard for a categorical distribution visualization, intended to convey at a glance how the test set’s samples are apportioned across the 12 domains.
